name: Six Senses Yao Noi
positioning: Island resort on Koh Yao Noi in Phang Nga Bay, with private-pool villas in tropical greenery and limestone pinnacles rising from the bay
best_for: Couples wanting a private-pool villa with a Phang Nga Bay backdrop
Families, with a Junior Eco Warrior Program for children

facts.text: The resort is on Koh Yao Noi in Phang Nga Bay, 45 minutes from Phuket.
The resort's backdrop recalls the Bond movie, with limestone pinnacles rising from the bay.
A GEM (Guest Experience Maker) arranges guests' activities.
The Ocean Retreat offers comfort, privacy and space for a whole group.
The Living Room serves authentic Thai cuisine by the beach.
Six Senses Spa offers wellness and healing treatments.
Children can join the Junior Eco Warrior Program.
Guests can join the resort's initiatives to preserve and regenerate the island's tropical flora and fauna.

highlights.text: Limestone pinnacles rising from Phang Nga Bay form the backdrop to the resort.
Villas are enveloped in tropical greenery and each has a private swimming pool.
Guests can meet hornbills and other birds that live on the island.
The Hilltop restaurant offers views with every menu.

considerations.text: The resort is on an island in Phang Nga Bay, about 45 minutes from Phuket.
WhataHotel notes the remote island location requires boat transfers.
